The Name

Where Digha Mux
Comes From

Our founder Engr. Ubah Chuma built this company from his own identity. His full family name — Ubadigha — carries a profound meaning in Igbo.

Digha means Multiplex in Igbo. Combined with the English word Multiplex it becomes Digha Mux — the same meaning in two languages. One name. One mission.

UBA
Wealth / AbundanceFrom the Igbo word for prosperity in all its forms
DIGHA
Multiplex (Igbo)Many things at once — Digha means Multiplex in Igbo
MUX
Multiplex (English)Digha + Mux — the same word, two languages, one vision
"Wealth is in different forms" — the meaning behind Ubadigha, the family name that became a company.

The Founder

Built by One Man's
Refusal to Stop

Born in Nnobi, Anambra State. By Primary 4 he was wiring circuits. By JSS3 he had built a working FM radio station that broadcast across his entire community — from scratch, with no funding and no mentor.

He scored 97% at Government Technical College Enugu — the highest score in the school's history. Dropped out of university twice for lack of funds. Declined the Vice Chancellor's personal letters urging him to return. He had bigger things to build.
